CARNIVAL NIGHT - lose those County Champ. 'blues' at this fancy dress dance; music supplied by Colin Bowden.
The date - Saturday, October 23rd, the scene - Belgrave Hall, the occasion - a return visit of Colin Bowden's All Star Jazz Band for the first Social of the season.
Lose your inhibitions and stomp to Colin Bowden for a mere 5/- per head November 19th - The Club DINNER & DANCE will be held at the sign of the Dog and Fox (Wimbledon Hill Hotel).

Once again our opening social of the season was given over to the music of Colin Bowden and his jazz band. This time he arrived with a different group to his previous visits and with the numbers increased from five to six, our patrons got even more value for money.
